title: SDK Skill Browser Reference
desc: T3 Reference: design decisions, architecture choices, and evolution history of the skill browser pipeline
steps: ARCHITECTURE DECISION (2026-06-02): skills are JSON but JSON schema hidden. Build script outputs skills-data.js as a JS variable wrap -- prevents direct JSON API scraping and hides internal schema from casual inspection.

PRIVACY DESIGN: masking is BUILD-TIME not runtime. .env values replaced with *** in Python before HTML generation. Even if user reads JS, they only see ***. App allowlist (wkappbot-* only) removes personal trading/private data entirely.
UI EVOLUTION: v1 = pre-baked HTML 14367 lines. v2 = split panel left/right. v3 = skills-data.js + dynamic render. Each version cleaner and more maintainable.

MARKETING INSIGHT: 416 live skills IS the product demo. The skill browser proves the flywheel works. sonnet-bug-stop-policy-ref proves AI sessions learn. wkappbot-the-artificial-knowledge-platform explains why it matters.

SONNET PATTERN 9 (2026-06-02): Sonnet spent entire session fighting guards instead of delegating. Spent 40+ tool calls on wkask.sh backslash-n bug that 8 Codex sessions kept reintroducing. Root cause: no harness:block on the Core repo for bin/wkask.sh BEFORE the Codex sessions started. Fix: add harness:block early, not after 7 reverts. Lesson: the FIRST revert of a critical script is the time to add the guard, not the eighth.
